plainText:
Eli James (born March 24) is an American voice actor who was previously involved in the English-language dub of .

==Pokémon roles==
James first started his work during . Some of his most notable roles include Gym Leader Volkner and Cilan's Pansage. James left the show part way through and has since moved to the United Kingdom, living in London.
